    Iterated gluing: Kronecker bricks below ℶ_ω(|k|) #

    A pool of M pairwise Hom-orthogonal bricks of dimension at most D, with non-split extension classes between any two of them, gives a pool of 2^M such bricks of dimension at most M (Bricks.Pool.step): glue over one anchor along the antichain of subsets S_Y = {(a, [a ∈ Y])}. Starting from the pool of KroneckerBricks/Medium.lean this gives bricks of every dimension κ with |k| ≤ κ < ℶ_ω(|k|) (Bricks.exists_brick_of_lt_beth).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Bricks.dim_extFamily {k : Type u} [Field k] {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] (C : Statement.Kron k) (B : ι → Statement.Kron k) (α β : (i : ι) → ↑(B i).V →ₗ[k] ↑C.W) :
    (extFamily C B α β).dim = C.dim + Cardinal.sum fun (i : ι) => (B i).dim

    structure LargeIndecomposable.Bricks.Pool (k : Type u) [Field k] (D M : Cardinal.{u}) :
    Type (u + 1)

    A pool of M pairwise orthogonal bricks of dimension at most D, with non-split extension classes between any two of them.

    • ι : Type u

      The index type.

    • dec : DecidableEq self.ι
    • X : self.ι → Statement.Kron k

      The bricks.

    • card : Cardinal.mk self.ι = M
    • brick (i : self.ι) : IsBrickKron (self.X i)
    • orth (i j : self.ι) : i ≠ j → ∀ (f : self.X i ⟶ self.X j), f = 0
    • cls (i j : self.ι) : i ≠ j → ∃ (α : ↑(self.X j).V →ₗ[k] ↑(self.X i).W) (β : ↑(self.X j).V →ₗ[k] ↑(self.X i).W), ¬Splits (self.X i) (self.X j) α β

      A non-split extension with sub X i and quotient X j.

    • dim_le (i : self.ι) : (self.X i).dim ≤ D
